description: Search EU + UK companies in official registries by name or identifier. Every company is one standard object with the same keys in all 29 countries (null where the register publishes no value): identifiers [{type, value}], vat_number and vat_number_source (register or rule; also in identifiers as type vat; `register`: published by the register (EE; LV from the State Revenue Service’s list of VAT payers; LT from the State Tax Inspectorate’s list; AU the ABN while GST-registered; TW the unified business number where the company is in the tax file) or the register confirms VAT registration and the number is the legal format of its identifier (NO, FI, BE). `rule`: built from the company identifier (ES `ES`+NIF, FR `FR`+key+SIREN, PL `PL`+NIP, NO `NO`+number+`MVA`, FI, SE `SE`+number+`01`, BE, HR `HR`+OIB, DK): the format is right, the registration is not confirmed (check it with `GET /vat/{number}`). Null where the register says the company is not VAT-registered (NO, FI), where a Latvian company is not on the State Revenue Service’s list of VAT payers, and where no rule exists (GB, IE, SK, CY, US, CA, JP, IL, BR, CO, SG, and EE without a published KMKR).), the standard legal_form abbreviation and legal_form_family beside the register's local_legal_form and local_legal_form_name, a standard status and stage beside the register's own local_status, one main activity_code with its scheme, label and NACE class, address with region, capital_amount and capital_eur, and registry_details for what only one register has (null when the dictionary does not recognise a stored value — never a guess). Use country to scope the search to Spain (BORME), France (BODACC), the UK (Companies House), Ireland (CRO), Poland (KRS), Norway (Brønnøysundregistrene), Finland (Kaupparekisteri), Sweden (Bolagsverket), Croatia (Sudski registar), Belgium (KBO/BCE), Denmark (CVR), Estonia (e-Business Register), Slovakia (RPO), Switzerland (Zefix), Latvia (Register of Enterprises), Cyprus (DRCOR), Romania (ONRC), Lithuania (JAR), Canada (Corporations Canada), Australia (ASIC and the ABR), Japan (National Tax Agency), Israel (Corporations Authority), Brazil (CNPJ), Colombia (RUES), Singapore (ACRA), Taiwan (GCIS), the Czech Republic (public register, Ministry of Justice, and RES), Germany (LEI-registered entities only, GLEIF), or the United States (state registers, SEC EDGAR and GLEIF). Fuzzy name results carry a match_score (0–100) and are ranked by relevance, best first. NOTE: "dissolved" means different things by country — ES/FR still exists pending liquidation, GB/IE/PL/NO/FI no longer exists — read status (the standard value), not local_status, to compare across countries. Norway and France include sole proprietorships (ENK, EI) as the register publishes them; a French company that opted out of publication (INSEE non-diffusible) has company_name null, status withheld and registry_details.non_diffusible true, is left out of name searches, the founding-date feed and event searches by name, and is found by SIREN or SIRET. A Spanish company closed by a merger is served as closed (local_status absorbed). A malformed identifier (a Spanish NIF must pass its control character), or a limit outside the documented range, is a 400 validation_error.

abn.description: Australian Business Number (11 digits, e.g. 49004028077; an ABN prefix and spaces are optional) — exact match, with country AU. A wrong check digit is a 400 validation_error, and with any other country it is a 400. A company's ACN or ARBN goes in company_number.

business_number.description: Canadian Business Number (CRA, 9 digits, e.g. 847871746; a 15-character program account such as 847871746RC0001 names the same number) — exact match, with country CA. Several federal corporations can carry the same Business Number, so the answer is a list. With any other country it is a 400.

company_number.description: Registry identifier — exact match. Resolves per country: Spanish NIF/CIF (A78053147), French SIREN, UK Companies House number (00445790, SC123456), the IE/PL/NO registration number, for country FI a Y-tunnus such as 0112038-9 (the hyphen is optional; a wrong check digit is a 400), for country SE an organisationsnummer such as 556012-5790 (the hyphen is optional; a wrong check digit, or a third digit below 2, is a 400), for country HR an MBS such as 080000604 (a dropped leading zero is restored; the check digit is advisory, so only a wrong length is a 400), for country BE an enterprise number such as 0417.497.106 (the dots and spaces are optional; a wrong check digit is a 400), or for country DK a CVR number such as 24256790 (eight digits; the mod-11 check is advisory, so only a number that is not eight digits is a 400), for country LT a juridinio asmens kodas such as 110053842 (nine digits, the ninth a check digit; an LT prefix is a VAT number and is refused), for country CA a corporation number such as 426160-7 (the last digit is a check digit), for country AU an ACN or ARBN such as 004 028 077, for country JP a 13-digit corporate number such as 1180301018771 (the first digit is a check digit), for country IL a company number such as 520013954 (nine digits starting 51, 52 or 56), for country BR a CNPJ such as 33.000.167/0001-01 (the 8-digit root finds the head office), for country CO a NIT such as 900843898-9, for country SG a UEN such as 196800306E, for country TW a unified business number such as 22099131, for country CZ an IČO such as 45274649 (eight digits), for country DE the 20-character LEI such as W38RGI023J3WT1HWRP32 (ISO 17442 check), or for country US a state code and register number such as NY-4424185, CIK- and the SEC number such as CIK-0000320193, or LEI- and the 20-character LEI (no check digit; the dash is optional).

country.description: Country code: ES (Spain, BORME), FR (France, BODACC), GB (UK, Companies House), IE (Ireland, CRO), PL (Poland, KRS), NO (Norway, Brønnøysundregistrene / Enhetsregisteret), FI (Finland, Kaupparekisteri, the Finnish Trade Register), SE (Sweden, Bolagsverket, the Swedish Companies Registration Office), HR (Croatia, Sudski registar, the Croatian court register), BE (Belgium, KBO/BCE, the Crossroads Bank for Enterprises), DK (Denmark, CVR, the Danish Central Business Register), EE (Estonia, the e-Business Register, RIK), SK (Slovakia, RPO, the Register of Legal Entities), CH (Switzerland, Zefix, the Swiss central business name index), LV (Latvia, the Register of Enterprises, Uzņēmumu reģistrs), CY (Cyprus, DRCOR, the Department of the Registrar of Companies and Intellectual Property), RO (Romania, ONRC, the National Trade Register Office), LT (Lithuania, JAR, the Register of Legal Entities), CA (Canada, Corporations Canada, federal corporations only), AU (Australia, ASIC and the Australian Business Register), JP (Japan, the National Tax Agency corporate number publication site), IL (Israel, the Corporations Authority), BR (Brazil, CNPJ, Receita Federal), CO (Colombia, RUES, Confecámaras), SG (Singapore, ACRA), TW (Taiwan, GCIS and the Ministry of Finance), CZ (Czech Republic, the public register of the Ministry of Justice and the Czech Statistical Office RES), DE (Germany, GLEIF LEI-registered entities only, not the commercial register), or US (United States: state business registers, SEC EDGAR and GLEIF). Ireland, Poland, Finland, Sweden, Croatia, Belgium, Denmark, Estonia, Slovakia, Switzerland, Latvia, Cyprus, Romania, Lithuania, Canada, Australia, Japan, Israel, Singapore, Colombia, Taiwan, Czech Republic, Germany, Brazil and the United States are company-level (companies only). Norway has companies and officers; Ireland, Poland and Norway have register-change events only, from 14 Oct 2026 (no gazette). Finland, Sweden, Belgium, Croatia, Denmark, Estonia, Slovakia, Switzerland, Latvia, Cyprus, Romania, Lithuania, Canada, Australia, Japan, Israel, Singapore, Colombia, Taiwan, Czech Republic, Germany, Brazil and the United States have register-change events (name, status, legal form and registered address; share capital for HR, EE, SK, CH, LV, LT, TW, BR and CZ), dated when the change first appears in the register data (for the United States, the weekly read of the registers that first sees it) and none before 2026-09-30, and monitoring. Company records from the Finnish Trade Register: legal name, legal form, status, registered address, activity code and dates; no officers and no registry-compliance signal. Corporate insolvency notices are linked by business ID. Sweden: Company records from the Swedish Companies Registration Office (Bolagsverket): legal name, legal form, status, registered address, activity code and dates; no officers and no registry-compliance signal, and sole traders (enskild näringsverksamhet) are never served. Corporate insolvency notices (konkurs, företagsrekonstruktion, ackordsförhandling; weekly, no court or case number) are linked by organisationsnummer. Croatia: Company records from the Croatian court register (Sudski registar): legal name, legal form, status, registered address, activity code and dates; no officers and no registry-compliance signal, and sole traders (trgovac pojedinac) are never served. Corporate insolvency notices (court decisions, with court and case number where the register states them) are linked by MBS. Belgium: Company records from the Crossroads Bank for Enterprises (KBO/BCE): legal name, legal form, status, registered address, activity code and dates; no officers, no registry-compliance signal and no insolvency notices (Belgium is not an insolvency market: a bankruptcy shows in the company status and in its register-change events), and enterprises of natural persons (eenmanszaak / entreprise individuelle) are never served. Denmark: Company records from the Danish Central Business Register (CVR): legal name, legal form, status (including the register's bankruptcy state), registered address, activity code and dates; no officers, no registry-compliance signal and no share capital, and sole proprietorships (enkeltmandsvirksomhed) and estates are never served. Corporate insolvency notices (konkurs and tvangsakkord from CVR credit information: one notice per proceeding, dated by the decision that opened it, with the latest stage of the proceeding; no court or case number) are linked by CVR number. Estonia: Company records from the Estonian e-Business Register (RIK): legal name, legal form, status (including liquidation and bankruptcy), registered address, activity code (EMTAK 2008 or 2025, per company) and dates; with register-change events and monitoring, but no officers, no registry-compliance signal and no insolvency notices. Sole traders (FIE) are never served, and the VAT number (KMKR) is searchable with `vat=`. Slovakia: Company records from the Slovak Register of Legal Entities (RPO): legal name, legal form, status (including bankruptcy (konkurz) and restructuring), registered address, activity code (SK NACE Rev. 2.1) and dates; with register-change events and monitoring, but no officers, no registry-compliance signal and no insolvency notices. Commercial legal persons only (no associations, foundations or other non-commercial entities); no VAT number (a `vat` search is refused); sole traders and other natural persons are never served. Romania: Company records from the National Trade Register Office (ONRC): legal name, legal form, status (including dissolution, liquidation, insolvency, reorganisation, bankruptcy and deregistration), registered address with the county, CAEN activity codes, the J registration number and EUID, and dates; with register-change events and monitoring, but no officers, no registry-compliance signal, no share capital and no insolvency notices. Natural persons and sole traders are never served. The CUI (2 to 10 digits, check digit advisory) is the company_number; the Romanian VAT number (RO plus the CUI, built by rule) is searchable with `vat=`. Cyprus: Company records from the Department of the Registrar of Companies and Intellectual Property (DRCOR): legal name, legal form, status (including strike-off pending, voluntary and compulsory liquidation and administration), registered address with the district and dates; with register-change events and monitoring, but no officers, no registry-compliance signal, no activity code, no share capital, no VAT number (a vat search is refused) and no insolvency notices. Companies and overseas companies only; trade names and partnerships are never served. Latvia: Company records from the Register of Enterprises of the Republic of Latvia (Uzņēmumu reģistrs): legal name, legal form, status (including liquidation, insolvency and legal protection proceedings), registered address with the region, share capital, previous names and dates; with register-change events and monitoring, but no officers, no registry-compliance signal, no activity code and no insolvency notices. Individual merchants and other natural persons are never served. The registration number (11 digits, an LV prefix optional, with a mod-11 check that is enforced) is the company_number, and the Latvian VAT number (LV plus the registration number) is searchable with `vat=`. Switzerland: Company records from Zefix, the Swiss central business name index: legal name, legal form, status (including liquidation), registered address with the canton and business purpose; with register-change events and monitoring, but no officers, no registry-compliance signal and no activity code (the register publishes no NOGA code). Legal entities and branches only; sole proprietorships (Einzelunternehmen) and other natural persons are never served. Corporate insolvency notices (SHAB) are linked by UID where the notice names the debtor's UID. The UID with its MWST, TVA or IVA suffix is searchable with `vat=`. United States: there is no national register, so the API serves company records from the business registers of New York, Colorado, Connecticut, Pennsylvania and Florida (state open data and public records) plus SEC filers (EDGAR) and LEI holders (GLEIF) from every state, Delaware included, as one record per state registration (domestic or foreign); numbers look like NY-4424185, CO-20091096973, DE-10684990, CIK-0000320193 or LEI-… and identifiers also carry the SEC CIK, the EIN of SEC filers and the LEI; New York and Pennsylvania publish active entities only (Florida serves active and inactive entities: profit corporations, limited liability companies, limited partnerships and non-profit corporations, domestic and foreign) and the SEC gives no legal status; updated weekly; company-level (no officers and no registry-compliance signal, with register-change events (dated by the weekly read) and monitoring), no VAT number (a `vat` search is refused), sole proprietorships never served, and not every US company. US insolvency notices are on insolvency_search and are not linked to the company records. US sources: New York Department of State, Colorado Secretary of State, Connecticut Secretary of the State, Pennsylvania Department of State (open data), Florida Department of State, Division of Corporations (public records), SEC EDGAR, GLEIF (CC0). Lithuania: Company records from the Register of Legal Entities (JAR): legal name, legal form, status, registered address, identifiers and dates; no officers or registry-compliance signal; register-change events (name, status, legal form and registered address, dated when the change first appears in the register data, none before the first load) and monitoring are available. Updated each working day. Company status includes liquidation, bankruptcy and restructuring; there are no insolvency notices. Activity codes follow NACE Rev. 2.1 (EVRK 2.1, class level; the 6-digit code is in registry_details). Share capital is held for UAB and AB only. VAT numbers come from the State Tax Inspectorate (VMI) list. Sole proprietorships, partnerships (KUB, TUB), branches, state enterprises and non-commercial bodies are never served. Credit: Contains data from the Register of Legal Entities (JAR), Registrų centras, the State Data Agency (Statistics Lithuania) and the State Tax Inspectorate (VMI), CC BY 4.0. Adapted by Prometiam. Canada: Company records from Corporations Canada (Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada): legal name, legal form, status, registered address, identifiers and dates; no officers or registry-compliance signal; register-change events (name, status, legal form and registered address, dated when the change first appears in the register data, none before the first load) and monitoring are available. Updated each working day. Federal corporations only (Canada Business Corporations Act, Canada Cooperatives Act and the repealed Canada Corporations Act Part I and Cooperative Associations Act); provincial and territorial corporations, not-for-profit corporations and boards of trade are not in the register. There is no insolvency, liquidation or bankruptcy status (that is the Office of the Superintendent of Bankruptcy and the courts), no activity code, share capital or VAT number. The Business Number is searchable with business_number=, and a corporation's other names are in registry_details. Credit: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada (Corporations Canada, Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada). Adapted by Prometiam. Australia: Company records from the Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC) and the Australian Business Register (ABR): legal name, legal form, status, registered address, identifiers and dates; no officers or registry-compliance signal; register-change events (name, status, legal form and registered address, dated when the change first appears in the register data, none before the first load) and monitoring are available. Updated weekly. Proprietary, public and foreign companies (ACN and ARBN) only; associations, cooperatives, other bodies, individuals and sole traders are never served. The register gives the state and the postcode, not a street address. ASIC does not separate liquidation from administration, so external administration shows as in_administration and there is no in_liquidation status; there are no insolvency notices. No activity code or share capital. The VAT number is the ABN when the ABN is active and registered for GST; an ABN is searchable with abn= and a GST-registered one with vat=. Data are licensed CC BY 3.0 AU (no sublicensing): the credit and licence link travel with every answer. Credit: Contains data from the Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC) Company Dataset and the Australian Business Register (ABN Bulk Extract), licensed CC BY 3.0 AU (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/au/). Adapted by Prometiam (joined, normalised, status derived). Japan: Company records from the National Tax Agency corporate number publication site: legal name, legal form, status, registered address, identifiers and dates; no officers or registry-compliance signal; register-change events (name, status, legal form and registered address, dated when the change first appears in the register data, none before the first load) and monitoring are available. Updated each working day, with a monthly full reconciliation. Companies (kabushiki, godo, gomei, goshi and tokurei yugen kaisha) and registered foreign companies only; national and local government bodies, associations and other corporations are never served. Status is active, deregistered or merged (with the successor's number): the register publishes no liquidation or insolvency state and there are no insolvency notices; no founding date, activity code, share capital or VAT number. The registration date is the date the corporate number was assigned and is null for companies that carry only the 5 October 2015 designation. Names are in Japanese; the English name, the kana reading and a romanised name are in registry_details. Credit: Source: National Tax Agency Corporate Number Publication Site (https://www.houjin-bangou.nta.go.jp/). Edited and processed by Prometiam; not a product of the National Tax Agency or the State. 出典：国税庁法人番号公表サイト（https://www.houjin-bangou.nta.go.jp/）。Prometiamが編集・加工して作成（国税庁が作成した情報ではありません）。 Israel: Company records from the Israeli Corporations Authority (Ministry of Justice): legal name, legal form, status, registered address, identifiers and dates; no officers or registry-compliance signal; register-change events (name, status, legal form and registered address, dated when the change first appears in the register data, none before the first load) and monitoring are available. Updated each working day. Israeli and registered foreign companies only; partnerships, cooperative societies, non-profit associations and sole traders are other registers and are not served. Company status includes liquidation, receivership, restructuring and insolvency proceedings; there are no insolvency notices. Names are in Hebrew, with the English name in registry_details where the register holds one. No activity code, share capital or VAT number. Credit: Contains information from the Israeli Corporations Authority, Ministry of Justice, via data.gov.il (used under the data.gov.il terms of use). Adapted by Prometiam; not an official register extract. Brazil: Company records from the Cadastro Nacional da Pessoa Jurídica (CNPJ), Receita Federal do Brasil: legal name, legal form, status, registered address, identifiers and dates; no officers or registry-compliance signal; register-change events (name, status, legal form and registered address, dated when the change first appears in the register data, none before the first load) and monitoring are available. Updated monthly (the Receita publishes one full file a month). Commercial legal persons only: limited companies (LTDA), corporations (S.A.), simple societies, single-member limited companies (EIRELI), public companies and mixed-capital companies, and cooperatives; sole traders (empresário individual, MEI included), non-profit entities, branches of foreign companies and every other natural-person form are never served. One record per CNPJ root, with the head office's 14-character CNPJ (shown 00.000.000/0001-91; the 8-digit root finds it too); branches are not served. Status is active, suspended, inapta (served as active_strike_off_pending), deregistered or merged; judicial recovery, bankruptcy, liquidation and intervention are read from the register's special situation, and there are no insolvency notices. The activity code is CNAE-Subclasses 2.3 (BR-CNAE-2.3), not a NACE code, and no NACE class is derived; the secondary codes are in registry_details. No VAT number (a vat search is refused), and no partners, officers or contacts. Credit: Contains data from the Cadastro Nacional da Pessoa Jurídica (CNPJ), Receita Federal do Brasil, published as open data (CC BY). Adapted by Prometiam. Colombia: Company records from Confecámaras (RUES, the Colombian chambers of commerce): legal name, legal form, status, registered address, identifiers and dates; no officers or registry-compliance signal; register-change events (name, status, legal form and registered address, dated when the change first appears in the register data, none before the first load) and monitoring are available. Updated each working day: the source's own update date is data_as_of and is in the credit. Companies of the commercial register only (S.A.S., Ltda., S.A., S. en C., S.C.A., collective companies, single-person companies (E.U.) and branches of foreign companies); natural persons, non-profit entities, cooperatives and public bodies are never served. The register has no address, share capital, contact, activity description or VAT number (a vat search is refused), and no liquidation state: liquidation, judicial liquidation and reorganisation are read from the company name and served as the status, and a cancelled registration is deregistered or merged. The registration may not be current although it reads active: last_renewal_year in registry_details is the last year it was renewed. company_name is the name without those markers and name_as_registered is the name as published. The activity code is the CIIU Rev.4 A.C. 4-digit code (CO-CIIU-REV4-AC), not a NACE code. No insolvency notices. The records are offered under CC BY-SA 4.0 (share-alike). Credit: Contains data from Confecámaras (RUES, Registro Único Empresarial y Social), via the Portal de Datos Abiertos www.datos.gov.co, last updated on the date shown in data_as_of, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). Adapted by Prometiam; the adapted Colombian records are offered under CC BY-SA 4.0. Singapore: Company records from the Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA): legal name, legal form, status, registered address, identifiers and dates; no officers or registry-compliance signal; register-change events (name, status, legal form and registered address, dated when the change first appears in the register data, none before the first load) and monitoring are available. Updated monthly. Local companies, limited liability partnerships (LLP) and registered foreign company branches only; sole proprietorships, general partnerships and limited partnerships are never served. Status includes liquidation, judicial management and receivership, and a struck-off, dissolved or amalgamated company is deregistered or merged; there are no insolvency notices. The register publishes no cessation date, share capital, GST (VAT) number (a vat search is refused), region or officers. The activity code is SSIC 2020 (5 digits, SG-SSIC-2020; a legacy 4-digit code carries no scheme) and no NACE class is derived. The annual return and accounts-due dates are in registry_details as published. API use of the data is licensed, not a right to the data itself. Credit: Contains information from ACRA Information on Corporate Entities and Entities Registered with ACRA accessed on the date shown in data_as_of from the Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA) via data.gov.sg, which is made available under the terms of the Singapore Open Data Licence version 1.0 (https://data.gov.sg/open-data-licence). Adapted by Prometiam; not an official ACRA extract. Taiwan: Company records from the Ministry of Economic Affairs (GCIS) and the Ministry of Finance (Fiscal Information Agency): legal name, legal form, status, registered address, identifiers and dates; no officers or registry-compliance signal; register-change events (name, status, legal form and registered address, dated when the change first appears in the register data, none before the first load) and monitoring are available. Updated each working day. Limited companies, companies limited by shares, unlimited companies, limited partnership companies and Taiwan branches of foreign companies only; sole proprietorships, partnerships, domestic branches, cooperatives, associations and representative offices are never served. Names and addresses are in Chinese (the register publishes no English name). The responsible person is not served. Status includes dissolution, reorganisation, receivership and bankruptcy. The VAT number is the unified business number where the company is in the Ministry of Finance tax file (searchable with vat=), else null. The activity code is the Ministry of Finance tax industry code (6 digits, TW-TAX-SIC), which is not a NACE code, and the other codes of the file are in secondary_activity_codes. The check digit of the number is advisory. No officers; no insolvency notices. Credit: Contains data from the Ministry of Economic Affairs (Department of Commerce, GCIS) and the Ministry of Finance (Fiscal Information Agency), Republic of China (Taiwan), released under the Open Government Data License, version 1.0 (https://data.gov.tw/license). Adapted by Prometiam, not a certified register extract. Czech Republic: Company records from the Czech public register (Veřejný rejstřík), kept by the regional courts and published by the Ministry of Justice as open data, with the region (kraj) and the activity code from the Czech Statistical Office Register of Economic Entities (RES): legal name, legal form, status, registered address, share capital, identifiers and dates; no officers, partners or shareholders and no registry-compliance signal; register-change events (name, status, legal form, registered address and share capital, dated when the change first appears in the register data, none before the first load, October 2026) and monitoring are available. Updated each working day. Commercial legal persons only (s.r.o., a.s., v.o.s., k.s., cooperatives, SE, SCE and EEIG); sole traders (OSVČ) and every other natural person, associations, foundations, trust funds, owners associations (SVJ) and branches are never served. Status includes liquidation, insolvency, bankruptcy and restructuring; there are no insolvency notices (the Czech Republic is not one of the twelve insolvency markets) and no financial statements. No VAT number: a vat search is refused. The activity code is CZ-NACE 2025. The IČO has eight digits and its check digit is advisory, so companies whose IČO fails it are served. The registering court and file number (for example B 1581, Městský soud v Praze) are in registry_details. Credit: Contains data from the public registers of the Czech Republic (Ministry of Justice, ISVR open data) and the Czech Statistical Office (RES, CC BY 4.0). Adapted by Prometiam. Germany (DE): LEI-registered entities only, from the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF) golden copy; not the German commercial register (Handelsregister). Company records only: the company number is the 20-character LEI (ISO 17442 check), searchable with company_number or lei; no officers, share capital, activity code or VAT number (a vat search is refused), no registry-compliance signal and no financial statements; register-change events (name, status, legal form, registered address, none before the first load, October 2026) and monitoring are available. Updated daily. GmbH, UG (haftungsbeschränkt), AG, KGaA, SE, OHG, KG (including GmbH & Co. KG), eG and PartG only; sole traders (e.K.) and other natural persons, GbR, associations (e.V.), foundations, public-law bodies, funds and branches are never served. Status is active, deregistered or merged; the LEI's own renewal status is registry_details.lei_status; the register court, register type and number (for example Amtsgericht München, HRB) are in registry_details. German corporate insolvency notices are served separately (Germany is one of the twelve insolvency markets) and are not linked to these records. Credit: Contains LEI data from the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF), available under CC0 1.0. LEI-registered entities only; not an extract of the German commercial register (Handelsregister). Defaults to first country in the API key allowlist.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor — pass the previous response's pagination.next_cursor to fetch the next page.

has_risk_flag.description: Spain only. Return only companies carrying a published risk flag (currently the AEAT >€600,000 tax-debtor list).

lei.description: Legal Entity Identifier (20 characters, ISO 17442 check) — exact match, with country DE only (an alias of company_number); any other country is a 400. LEI-registered German entities only, not the Handelsregister.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1–100, default 20).

local_status.description: Filter by the register's own status value (for example dissolved for GB, radiated for FR). Not together with status; outside ES it needs a name or company_number, like status.

nif.description: Spanish NIF/CIF — exact match, e.g. A78053147. Alias of company_number.

nip.description: Polish NIP (10 digits), exact match — use with country PL. The KRS number goes on company_number.

oib.description: Croatian OIB (11 digits), exact match — use with country HR. The ISO 7064 check digit is verified and a wrong one is a 400. The MBS goes on company_number.

regon.description: Polish REGON (9 or 14 digits), exact match — use with country PL.

risk_flag_type.description: Restrict to one flag type. registry_compliance also works for GB, IE and NO.

status.description: Filter by the standard status, the same list in every country. Outside ES it must be combined with a name/company_number/siren/siret/nip/regon/oib.

vat.description: VAT number — exact match, with its country prefix or without (ES ESA28015865, FR FR+key+SIREN, PL PL+NIP, NO NO+number+MVA; a malformed or wrong-country value is a 400). Otherwise an alias of company_number. For country FI, the Finnish VAT number FI plus the eight digits of the Y-tunnus, e.g. FI01120389; for country SE, the Swedish VAT number SE plus the ten digits of the organisationsnummer and 01, e.g. SE556012579001; for country HR, the Croatian VAT number HR plus the eleven digits of the OIB, e.g. HR27759560625; for country BE, the Belgian VAT number BE plus the ten digits of the enterprise number, e.g. BE0417497106; for country DK, the Danish VAT number DK plus the eight digits of the CVR number, e.g. DK24256790; for country EE, the Estonian VAT number (KMKR) EE plus nine digits, e.g. EE100354546, where the register publishes it (it is not the registry code; a VAT group number can be shared by the members of the group, so a search can return more than one company); for country CH, the Swiss VAT number, the UID followed by MWST, TVA or IVA, e.g. CHE-103.867.266 MWST; for country LV, the Latvian VAT number, LV plus the eleven digits of the registration number, e.g. LV40003032949; for country RO, the Romanian VAT number, RO plus the CUI, e.g. RO5022670 (built by rule, the registration is not confirmed); for country LT, the Lithuanian VAT number, LT plus 9 or 12 digits, e.g. LT100538411, where the State Tax Inspectorate (VMI) lists the company; for country AU, the GST number, the eleven-digit ABN, e.g. 49004028077, found only while the ABN is active and registered for GST; for country TW, the unified business number, e.g. 22099131, where the company is in the Ministry of Finance tax file; Slovakia, Cyprus, the United States, Canada, Japan, Israel, Brazil, Colombia, Singapore and the Czech Republic have no VAT number, so vat is refused for country SK, CY, US, CA, JP, IL, BR, CO, SG and CZ.
